name: DuckDB Analytical Reflection Layer
description: Build the DuckDB-powered retrospective learning loop: which packet families propagate fastest, which frameworks produce repeated failures, which dharma signals correlate with merged PRs, which codex entries are going stale, and which agent routes produce bad matches.
purpose: Enable inspectable, local-first product analytics without cloud dependency. DuckDB queries run against snapshots, never against the transactional store directly.
acceptanceCriteria: DuckDB consumes snapshots from PGlite and events from Valkey
Analytical queries answer product questions without touching transactional store
Embedded Node.js client integration for in-process queries
File-backed databases for persistence across restarts
Queries never impact PGlite transaction latency
